title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
title_zh: 学习任务还是学习验证器？重新思考具身自我改进中的标准暴露

paragraphs.en: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark’s success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark’s criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.
paragraphs.zh: 自我提升的具身智能体正在机器人仿真基准上被越来越多地开发与比较。 近期的一些工作将基准的成功标准暴露给学习型智能体，我们将这种做法称为标准暴露（Criteria Exposure, CE）。 这些标准最初是为验证通过模仿学习训练的策略而编写的，往往比相应的语言指令要求更多，因此此类验证器给出的分数可能无法如实反映指令任务是否完成，尤其是对于智能体编写的机器人控制程序。 随着具身编码智能体报告的基准分数不断攀升，一个自然的问题随之而来：当编码智能体接触到基准的标准时，它生成的是更能完成指令任务的代码，还是仅仅过拟合验证标准的代码？ 我们使用一个自我提升的智能体在有无 CE 的条件下进行受控实验，发现在有 CE 时，智能体很快就能产出在给定标准下成功率更高的代码，但当标准在不偏离原始指令的情况下被轻微改动时，这一优势便消失了。 更重要的是，智能体在 CE 下发展出的技能在不同任务之间的迁移效果很差。 我们进一步提出忠实于指令的标准，并证明它们能更好地反映智能体生成程序的性能。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: embodied agent, self-improvement, robot policy evaluation
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：具身智能体、自我改进、机器人策略评估

paragraphs.en: Agents that write code to control robots with multimodal language models complete many manipulation tasks zero-shot [ 19 , 15 , 12 , 29 ] , but preserve nothing from one episode to the next, which makes self-improvement across episodes a natural next step [ 28 , 31 , 36 ] . Such agents are developed and compared on embodied simulation benchmarks [ 9 , 20 , 22 ] originally built to evaluate end-to-end policies trained by imitating demonstrations, such as vision-language-action (VLA) models [ 6 , 17 , 4 , 25 ] and world action models (WAMs) [ 26 ] . The actual success criteria of these benchmarks often ask for more than the instruction; in the press_by_number task of RoboDojo, for instance, the criteria require the blue button to be pressed exactly twice, between two groups of red presses, which the instruction never states ( figure 1 a). For policies trained by imitation, this gap is harmless, since their demonstrations already contain every detail the criteria verify: order, counts, end states, and the return of both arms. An agent that receives only the instruction, however, lacks this information. Existing self-improving methods therefore expose the criteria to the agent to different degrees, from rule descriptions [ 10 ] and published scoring tables [ 18 , 13 ] to numeric thresholds [ 14 ] , formal goal predicates [ 32 ] , and the source code of the verifier [ 3 ] . A robot in the real world, by contrast, receives only its instruction and, at most, a success judged by a human or a VLM. Our research question is: when a self-improving embodied agent is exposed to the success criteria, does the code it iteratively produces better perform the instructed task, or simply overfit to the verification criteria?

paragraphs.en: Studies of benchmark validity and of specification gaming show that criteria can demand more than the instruction states and that agents exploit a verifier they can inspect [ 16 , 40 , 37 ] , but we are not aware of work that measures how much of a reported gain in embodied self-improvement comes from reading the criteria, or whether it survives when the criteria change. We therefore compare two settings of one fixed self-improvement loop, in which a frozen coding agent acts and a learner agent turns its episodes into a library of skills and memory: with Criteria Exposure (w/ CE), the learner reads the criteria; without it (w/o CE), the learner sees only whether each episode succeeded. We ask three questions: on which tasks exposure raises the score; whether its lead survives a change of criteria, both of the criteria that judge the episodes and of the criteria the learner reads; and whether what it adds carries over to new tasks and to two further benchmarks, LIBERO-PRO and RoboCasa365. To change the criteria, we rewrite them for the RoboDojo tasks whose criteria ask for more than the instruction, so that they verify only what the instruction asks. On these tasks every episode is judged by both versions, and in a separate run the learner reads the rewritten criteria instead of the original ones.

paragraphs.en: Our experiments reveal three findings. First, under the original criteria, exposure helps only on tasks whose criteria ask for more than the instruction; when criteria and instruction agree, learning from success alone does just as well. Second, the score of exposure follows the criteria it read: when the same episodes are judged by instruction-faithful criteria, its advantage disappears, as the exposed libraries lose successes while the success-only libraries gain them ( figure 1 b); conversely, a library learned from the rewritten criteria scores far lower when judged by the original ones. Third, the lead of exposure does not reappear on new RoboDojo tasks, and across benchmarks neither the exposed nor the success-only library gives a clear gain over the empty library; only experience gathered within the target benchmark does.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验揭示了三点发现。 首先，在原始准则下，曝光只在准则要求高于指令的任务上有帮助；当准则与指令一致时，仅从成功中学习的效果同样好。 其次，曝光的分数遵循它所阅读的准则：当同样的回合由忠实于指令的准则评判时，其优势便消失了，因为被曝光的库失去了成功，而仅从成功学习的库获得了这些成功（图 1 b）；相反，从改写后的准则中学到的库，在用原始准则评判时得分要低得多。 第三，曝光的优势在新 RoboDojo 任务上并未重现，并且在各基准上，无论是曝光库还是仅成功库都没有比空库带来明显的收益；只有在目标基准内部积累的经验才有效果。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these results suggest a practical principle for evaluating embodied self-improvement: the learner should receive only the feedback a robot would receive in the real world, and the benchmark’s criteria should verify what the instruction says. A gain that holds when the criteria are changed but still agree with the instruction reflects what the agent has learned about the task. Seen this way, whether the learner reads the criteria is not an implementation detail of a self-improving agent but a choice about measurement, and it determines what a reported gain means.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些结果为评估具身自我改进提出了一个实用原则：学习者只应获得机器人在真实世界中会获得的反馈，且基准的评判标准应核验指令所述的内容。 当评判标准被改变但仍与指令一致时依然成立的提升，反映的才是智能体对任务真正学到的东西。 由此看来，学习者是否阅读评判标准并非一个自我改进智能体的实现细节，而是一种关于测量的选择，它决定了所报告的提升意味着什么。

paragraphs.en: Code-writing embodied agents and their benchmarks. Language models plan and act for robots by selecting skills [ 1 ] , writing policy code [ 19 ] , or composing value maps [ 15 ] ; recent agents close the loop with code replanning and thin tool layers [ 12 , 29 , 13 ] , and frontier models now control robots zero-shot. These agents are evaluated on benchmarks built for vision-language-action policies trained on demonstrations [ 6 , 17 , 4 , 25 ] : RoboDojo [ 9 ] , LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO [ 20 , 38 ] , RoboCasa365 [ 22 ] , and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 8 ] . These works score agents with criteria written for demonstration-trained policies; whether the criteria verify only what the instruction asks is rarely examined on its own, and we measure how this gap enters the score of a self-improving agent.

paragraphs.en: Self-improving agents and the feedback their learners see. In digital domains, programs are evolved against automatic evaluators [ 23 , 34 ] , agents reflect on textual feedback [ 28 , 36 ] , skills are verified in a game world [ 31 ] , and code is revised against tests [ 33 ] . Embodied systems differ in how much of the success criteria their learners or agents see. Some give only success or keep the grader isolated [ 27 , 21 ] ; others add rule descriptions with coarse feedback [ 10 ] , published scoring tables and partial numeric thresholds [ 18 , 13 , 14 ] , formal goal predicates [ 32 ] , or the source code of the verifier [ 3 ] . In RATs, the verifier reads goal predicates and ground truth while the policy writer’s side is filtered [ 35 ] . In these systems the amount of criteria information is mostly fixed by design rather than varied as an experimental factor. The closest comparison is an ablation of EmbodiedEvo between task descriptions alone and descriptions with the wiki, but both arms are judged by the original criteria [ 18 ] . We treat exposure as the variable and test what it gains under a second set of criteria.

paragraphs.en: Specification gaming and benchmark validity. Optimizing a proxy diverges from the intended objective [ 2 , 30 ] , with measurable effects of reward misspecification [ 24 ] . paragraphs.en: This section describes the controlled study we use to analyze what a self-improving embodied agent learns from the success criteria. The study compares two settings of one loop, w/ CE and w/o CE, and answers three questions: where exposure raises the score under the original criteria, whether the advantage holds when the criteria change, and whether the library carries over to new tasks and benchmarks. We describe in turn the loop and its two settings, criteria-limited tasks, instruction-faithful criteria, and the evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: We call a task criteria-limited if C τ C_{\tau} disagrees with S τ S_{\tau} on some trajectories, either by rejecting a trajectory S τ S_{\tau} accepts or by accepting one S τ S_{\tau} rejects (criteria looser than the instruction); all other tasks are faithful . Such tasks appear in every benchmark we examined, RoboDojo, LIBERO [ 20 ] (whose instructions and goals LIBERO-PRO keeps), RoboCasa365 and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 8 ] , and their disagreements fall into a few kinds. The criteria may ask for more than the instruction states, such as an order, a count or an end state: in RoboDojo, press_by_number requires a button protocol its instruction never gives. They may be stricter than the instruction needs, such as an unstated tolerance for an object resting on another in LIBERO. They may contradict the instruction, as in a LIBERO task that asks to stack a bowl on the front bowl while its criteria require the back one. Or they may verify less than the instruction asks: in RoboTwin 2.0, shake_bottle_horizontally succeeds once the bottle is lifted.

paragraphs.en: We rewrite criteria and re-judge episodes on RoboDojo only. Its criteria report a score and stages besides success, so an exposed learner reads the most complete information there, and we compared the criteria of all of its tasks with their instructions; rewriting the criteria of other benchmarks and repeating these experiments on them is left to future work. We distinguish seven types: hidden rules, hard thresholds, timing and irreversible events, criteria defects, extra end states, loose criteria, and contradictions. In RoboDojo, after a manual review of every task, the 20 criteria-limited tasks have 26 variants, and hidden rules and hard thresholds are the most common types. Criteria-limited is defined with respect to the instruction the agent receives at reset; the RoboDojo website publishes part of these rules in its task descriptions and scoring tables.

paragraphs.en: For each criteria-limited task we rewrite only the criteria code, never the instruction, and leave the original repository untouched: hidden rules are removed or relaxed, defects fixed, hard thresholds relaxed to what still clearly satisfies the instruction, loose criteria tightened where the simulator state can detect the difference, and the return of both arms kept. Each evaluation episode is then judged by both criteria, giving SR orig \text{SR}^{\text{orig}} and SR faith \text{SR}^{\text{faith}} . Since both criteria score the same instruction on the same episode, any difference between the two success rates comes from what the criteria verify, not from behavior. paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of exposure, the two settings of each comparison use the same actor, primitives, round budget and development layouts. The 25 learned tasks comprise 16 criteria-limited and 9 faithful tasks, grouped in advance by whether their criteria were rewritten; Appendix A.4 lists the tasks. Development uses layouts 0–4 of seed 1 and testing layouts 0–19 of seed 0. We report the success rate (SR) and compare settings layout by layout. All experiments use the same actor and learner. To reuse libraries, we distill the libraries of ten source tasks into one shared library and apply it to disjoint target tasks, in RoboDojo and on two further benchmarks with aligned primitives.
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离暴露效应的影响，每项比较中的两个设置使用相同的智能体、原语、回合预算和开发布局。 这25个学习任务包含16个准则受限任务和9个忠实任务，并预先按其准则是否被改写进行分组；附录A.4列出了这些任务。 开发使用种子1的布局0–4，测试使用种子0的布局0–19。 我们报告成功率（SR），并逐布局比较各设置。 所有实验使用相同的智能体和学习器。 为了复用库，我们将十个源任务的库蒸馏为一个共享库，并将其应用于不相交的目标任务，实验在RoboDojo以及两个使用对齐原语的更多基准上进行。

paragraphs.en: We use three simulated benchmarks with different roles. RoboDojo is the main benchmark: its rule-based criteria report a score and stages, and all three questions are answered on it. LIBERO-PRO is a single-arm tabletop benchmark where zero-shot success is already near the ceiling; it tests whether transfer still has room at high scores. RoboCasa365 has household kitchen scenes and the lowest zero-shot scores; it tests cross-benchmark experience and also hosts in-benchmark learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三个具有不同角色的模拟基准。 RoboDojo 是主要基准：其基于规则的评判标准会给出分数和阶段，并且三个问题都在其上得到回答。 LIBERO-PRO 是一个单臂桌面基准，其零样本成功率已接近上限；它测试在高分情况下迁移是否仍有提升空间。 RoboCasa365 包含家庭厨房场景且零样本分数最低；它测试跨基准的经验，同时也支持基准内学习。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and figure 3 show three patterns. First, learning from success alone doubles success, from 24.6% to 47.8%, and reading the criteria adds another 14.2 points (62.0%). Second, this extra gain comes from the criteria-limited tasks: on faithful tasks the two settings are level (83.3% and 80.6%), while on criteria-limited tasks exposure leads, 51.6% against 27.8%. Third, among criteria-limited tasks the lead depends on whether an unstated rule shows in failed episodes: in build_tower the leftover blocks reveal it and both settings reach 20/20, whereas the button protocol of press_by_number, blue pressed twice and between the two red groups, never shows, and the success-only learner never finds it.
paragraphs.zh: 表1和图3展示了三种模式。 第一，仅从成功中学习就能使成功率翻倍，从24.6%提升到47.8%，而阅读评价标准又额外增加了14.2个百分点（62.0%）。 第二，这一额外收益来自标准受限任务：在忠实任务上，两种设置水平相当（83.3%和80.6%），而在标准受限任务上，接触评价标准的方法领先，51.6%对27.8%。 第三，在标准受限任务中，领先幅度取决于一条未明说的规则是否会在失败的回合中显现：在build_tower中，剩余的积木揭示了这条规则，两种设置都达到20/20；而在press_by_number中，按钮规则——蓝色按两次且位于两组红色之间——从未显现，仅从成功中学习的智能体永远无法发现它。

paragraphs.en: Exposure pays off only where the criteria ask for more than the instruction. Richer feedback is often assumed to make self-improvement better. Our results show a condition: when the criteria verify what the instruction says, success alone tells the learner what the task requires, and what remains, a reliable procedure, is learned equally well in both settings. Exposure helps only with rules that the instruction omits and that failures do not reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当评价标准比指令要求得更多时，暴露才有回报。 人们通常认为更丰富的反馈能让自我改进变得更好。 我们的结果给出了一个条件：当评价标准验证的正是指令所说的内容时，仅凭成功就能告诉学习者任务的要求以及尚缺什么，而剩下的部分——一个可靠的流程——在两种设置下都能学得同样好。 暴露只对那些指令未提及、且失败也无法揭示的规则有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: The advantage of exposure measures the benchmark as much as the agent. Because it comes from what the instruction leaves out, the gain of exposure grows with the gap between a benchmark’s instructions and its criteria. Some of what the criteria reveal is legitimate task knowledge, but it belongs in the instruction: benchmarks that state in the instruction what their criteria verify (counts, order, end states, the reset of the arms) and release versioned criteria with a comparison against the instructions would let self-improvement be compared on the task alone.
paragraphs.zh: 暴露度的优势对基准的衡量程度和对智能体的衡量程度是一样的。 由于它来源于指令所遗漏的内容，暴露度的增益会随基准的指令与其评判标准之间的差距增大而增长。 评判标准所揭示的内容中有一部分是正当的任务知识，但它本应属于指令：如果基准在指令中说明其评判标准所验证的内容（计数、顺序、最终状态、机械臂的重置），并发布带有与指令对比的版本化评判标准，就能让自我改进仅就任务本身进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the lead of exposure disappear. paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们让学习器改为阅读 C faith C^{\text{faith}}（十个任务，五轮迭代），并将由此得到的库 ℒ CE faith \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{faith}} 与 ℒ CE orig \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{orig}} 在相同的十个任务上进行比较，每个任务分别由其学习器所阅读的标准和另一标准来评判。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that each exposed library does well only under the criteria it read: ℒ CE orig \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{orig}} falls from 57.0% to 45.0% under C faith C^{\text{faith}} , and ℒ CE faith \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{faith}} from 65.0% to 13.5% under C orig C^{\text{orig}} . The fall is steeper for ℒ CE faith \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{faith}} because the two directions differ: C faith C^{\text{faith}} mostly removes or relaxes the hidden rules and thresholds of C orig C^{\text{orig}} , so moving ℒ CE orig \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{orig}} to C faith C^{\text{faith}} loosens the verification, whereas moving ℒ CE faith \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}^{\text{faith}} to C orig C^{\text{orig}} adds back every rule the library never saw. paragraphs.en: Exposure makes self-improvement fit the criteria rather than learn the instructed task. A higher score from reading the criteria is commonly taken as faster learning of the task. A learner that reads the criteria, however, revises the library until it passes the verifier it reads, so the library learns the task only as far as the criteria agree with the instruction. Under instruction-faithful criteria the exposed library loses successes that the success-only library gains, and each exposed library scores best only under the criteria it read: on press_by_number it solves all 20 layouts under C orig C^{\text{orig}} and none under C faith C^{\text{faith}} , and the library that read C faith C^{\text{faith}} solves 65.0% of its test episodes under C faith C^{\text{faith}} but 13.5% under C orig C^{\text{orig}} . Self-improvement should therefore be measured without exposure by default, with the success rate under instruction-faithful criteria reported alongside: a robot in the real world has no criteria code, so the part of a gain that survives a change of criteria is the part to expect there.
paragraphs.zh: 暴露使自我改进去迎合评判标准，而不是学习所指定的任务。 从阅读评判标准中获得更高分数，通常被解读为更快地学会了任务。 然而，一个阅读了评判标准的学习者会不断修改其库，直到通过它所读到的验证器，因此只有当评判标准与指令一致时，该库才算学会了任务。 在忠实于指令的评判标准下，暴露的库失去了仅以成败为标准时获得的成功，且每个暴露的库只有在它所读的评判标准下得分最高：在 press_by_number 上，读取 C orig C^{\text{orig}} 的库在 C orig C^{\text{orig}} 下解出全部 20 个布局，在 C faith C^{\text{faith}} 下则一个也解不出，而读取 C faith C^{\text{faith}} 的库在 C faith C^{\text{faith}} 下解出其测试回合的 65.0%，在 C orig C^{\text{orig}} 下仅解出 13.5%。 因此，默认情况下应在无暴露的条件下衡量自我改进，同时报告在忠实于指令的评判标准下的成功率：现实世界中的机器人没有评判标准代码，只有经受住评判标准变更的那部分收益才是可以期待的收益。

paragraphs.en: Exposure changes what the learner writes down. A learner that reads the criteria can explain a failure by the condition it violated, so its experience is phrased in the terms of one verifier; a learner that sees only success has to find a physical cause, and its rules are closer to regularities of the robot. About a third of the exposed memory entries cite the criteria code, and none of the success-only ones do.
paragraphs.zh: 接触这些信息会改变学习者记下的内容。 阅读过判定标准的学习者能够依据所违反的条件来解释一次失败，因此其经验是用某个验证器的术语表述的；而只看到成功的学习者则必须寻找物理原因，其规则更接近于机器人本身的规律。 接触组约三分之一的记忆条目引用了判定标准代码，而仅成功组的记忆条目则没有任何一条这样做。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we carry the libraries to new tasks in RoboDojo and to two further benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们将这些库迁移到 RoboDojo 中的新任务以及另外两个基准测试上。

paragraphs.en: We distill the libraries of ten learned tasks into one library per setting and apply it to ten target tasks that none of the source tasks covers, paired with the empty library on the same layouts.

paragraphs.en: Both settings help on the target tasks (first row of table 2 ): the empty library solves 65 of 200 episodes, the success-only library 80 and the exposed one 71. The 14.2-point lead of exposure on its own tasks does not reappear.

paragraphs.en: What exposure adds is specific to the task it was learned on. One might expect the setting that scores higher on its own tasks to transfer better. It does not: the lead of exposure disappears on target tasks. Exposed experience carries the conditions and precision needed to pass one task’s criteria, which become noise or overhead elsewhere, whereas rules about the gripper hold across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 暴露（exposure）所带来的增益仅对它所学时的那个任务有效。 人们可能预期，在自身任务上得分更高的设置会有更好的迁移效果。 但事实并非如此：暴露带来的领先优势在目标任务上消失了。 暴露式经验承载的是通过某个任务评判标准所需的条件与精度，这些在别处就成了噪声或开销；而关于夹爪（gripper）的规则则能跨任务通用。

paragraphs.en: Experience transfers where the bottleneck is shared. Within a benchmark the robot, the scenes and perception stay the same, and learned rules carry over. paragraphs.en: Samples are small and the mechanisms are inferred. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we studied what a self-improving embodied agent learns when it reads the success criteria, by comparing one self-improvement loop with and without Criteria Exposure, under the benchmark’s own and instruction-faithful criteria, and on new tasks and benchmarks. Our results show that self-improvement from success alone is real and survives a change of criteria, whereas the score that Criteria Exposure adds comes mainly from satisfying the criteria that were read: it appears only where the criteria and the instruction disagree, disappears under instruction-faithful criteria, and across benchmarks neither the exposed nor the success-only library gives a clear gain, while only in-benchmark experience helps. These findings provide a more careful reading of reported self-improvement gains on embodied benchmarks and practical guidance for measuring them: use the feedback a robot receives in the real world, and judge by criteria that verify what the instruction says. A robot in the real world never sees its verifier; the agent we measure should not either.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了具身智能体在阅读成功标准后会学到什么：我们在基准自带标准与忠实于指令的标准两种条件下，对比了有 Criteria Exposure（标准暴露）与没有 Criteria Exposure 的自我改进循环，并在新任务和新基准上进行了测试。 我们的结果表明，仅凭成功的自我改进是真实存在的，并且在更换标准后依然成立；而 Criteria Exposure 带来的分数提升主要来自满足被阅读过的那些标准：这种提升只出现在标准与指令不一致的地方，在忠实于指令的标准下会消失，并且跨基准来看，无论是暴露过标准的经验库还是仅凭成功的经验库都没有带来明显收益，只有基准内的经验才有帮助。 这些发现为具身基准上所报告的自我改进收益提供了更审慎的解读，也为如何度量这类收益提供了实践指导：使用机器人在真实世界中获得的反馈，并以能够验证指令所述内容的标准来进行评判。 真实世界中的机器人永远看不到它的验证器；我们所度量的智能体也不应看到。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. RoboDojo’s simulation track uses a dual-arm ARX-X5 with RGB observations only; its 42 tasks span five capability dimensions. paragraphs.en: Statistics. Development batches are noisy: rerunning one library on one layout changes the verdict in 4% of cases, and the two round-0 batches of the same empty library differ in at least 13% of episodes. paragraphs.en: Actor. GPT-6 Astra writes one code cell per MLLM call against PyRUA-Lean’s frozen robo API [ 29 ] : RGB perception (SAM 3 [ 7 ] and multi-view measurement) and motion primitives, with no VLA policy, depth or simulator state. The library is installed as a package library/: cells import its skills, and its live memory entries are appended to the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者。 GPT-6 Astra 在每次 MLLM 调用时针对 PyRUA-Lean 的冻结 robo API [ 29 ] 编写一个代码单元：RGB 感知（SAM 3 [ 7 ] 与多视角测量）以及运动原语，不使用 VLA 策略、深度信息或仿真器状态。 该库作为包安装在 library/ 中：代码单元导入其中的技能，并且其实时记忆条目会被附加到提示词中。

sents.en: GPT-6 Astra writes one code cell per MLLM call against PyRUA-Lean’s frozen robo API [ 29 ] : RGB perception (SAM 3 [ 7 ] and multi-view measurement) and motion primitives, with no VLA policy, depth or simulator state.
sents.zh: GPT-6 Astra 在每次 MLLM 调用时针对 PyRUA-Lean 的冻结 robo API [ 29 ] 编写一个代码单元：RGB 感知（SAM 3 [ 7 ] 与多视角测量）以及运动原语，不使用 VLA 策略、深度信息或仿真器状态。

sents.en: The library is installed as a package library/: cells import its skills, and its live memory entries are appended to the prompt.
sents.zh: 该库作为包安装在 library/ 中：代码单元导入其中的技能，并且其实时记忆条目会被附加到提示词中。

paragraphs.en: Library. A skill is a function of robo that imports only standard modules, numpy and other library modules, does no I/O and returns {"ok": …, "why": …, …}. A memory entry is ## {task}-<stage>-<nnn> followed by stage, symptom, applies, do, status and evidence. A task’s library holds at most 40,000 characters, all of which the actor reads.
paragraphs.zh: 库。 技能（skill）是 robo 的一个函数，它只导入标准模块、numpy 及其他库模块，不做任何 I/O，并返回 {"ok": …, "why": …, …}。 一条记忆条目的格式为 ## {task}-<stage>-<nnn>，后跟 stage、symptom、applies、do、status 和 evidence。 一个任务的库最多容纳 40,000 个字符，智能体会读取其全部内容。

Claude Code reads the session, the task’s dev runs, the API source and, with Criteria Exposure, the task’s criteria; it writes only the candidate library, its verification rollouts and its notes. Without Criteria Exposure, criteria, scores and stages are removed from the evidence.

paragraphs.en: Acceptance and rollback. A candidate may change only the task’s own directory, must keep every memory entry identifier, must cite a judged rollout or dev batch for each entry newly marked dev_verified, and must pass the static skill rules and the size limit; none of this looks at success, and no candidate was refused. The active revision rolls back to the best earlier complete batch when a complete batch has two or more fewer successes; ties go to the batch that passed more stages, and a batch with an episode lost to infrastructure neither triggers a rollback nor becomes the best.
paragraphs.zh: 验收与回滚。 候选只能修改任务自身的目录，必须保留每个记忆条目标识符，必须为每个新标记为 dev_verified 的条目引用一次已判定的 rollout 或开发批次，并且必须通过静态技能规则和大小限制；这些都不涉及成功与否，也没有任何候选被拒绝。 当一个完整批次的成功数比之前少两个或以上时，当前生效的修订会回滚到之前最好的完整批次；平局时选择通过更多阶段的批次，而一个因基础设施问题丢失了回合的批次既不会触发回滚，也不会成为最佳批次。

paragraphs.en: The 25 learned tasks are grouped by whether their criteria were rewritten. Layouts that the benchmark marks unstable are replaced by the next layout in the official order. Under dual judging an episode ends early only when both criteria have reached a verdict, so neither verdict is truncated.
paragraphs.zh: 这 25 个已学习的任务按照其标准是否被重写进行分组。 基准测试标记为不稳定的布局会被官方顺序中的下一个布局替换。 在双重评判下，只有当两个标准都得出结论时，回合才会提前结束，因此任何一个结论都不会被截断。

paragraphs.en: RoboDojo criteria are sequences of stages: check stages in order, final_check at termination, and trigger_check, evaluated only at the step its condition becomes true; query requires exact counts and fails the episode for good once a count is exceeded; conditions nest with alternating AND and OR. Of the 42 tasks, 33 require both arms to return within 15 cm and 20° of home, while only 5 instructions ask for a reset.
paragraphs.zh: RoboDojo 的判据由阶段序列构成：按顺序检查各阶段，终止时执行 final_check，而 trigger_check 仅在其条件变为真的那一步进行评估；query 要求精确计数，一旦超过计数即永久判该回合失败；条件以 AND 和 OR 交替嵌套。 在 42 个任务中，有 33 个要求双臂回到距离初始位 15 cm 且角度偏差 20° 以内的位置，而只有 5 条指令要求重置。

paragraphs.en: For each task we compare gen_instruction, run_reward, get_score and the configuration, grade the severity as high, medium or low, and confirm by hand; the review is mainly a static reading of the code.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们比较 gen_instruction、run_reward、get_score 及其配置，将严重程度评为高、中或低，并进行人工确认；评审主要是对代码的静态阅读。

paragraphs.en: Hidden rule : the criteria verify conditions the instruction does not state (order, counts, relative position), e.g. the button protocol of press_by_number or the tile to draw in make_kong.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏规则：标准验证了指令中未说明的条件（顺序、数量、相对位置），例如 press_by_number 的按键协议，或 make_kong 中要摸的牌。

paragraphs.en: Hard threshold : the tolerance is stricter than clearly satisfying the instruction requires, e.g. 97% of the liquid in pour_liquid_into_cup.
paragraphs.zh: 硬阈值：容差比“明确满足指令”的要求更严格，例如 pour_liquid_into_cup 中 97% 的液体。

paragraphs.en: Timing, event triggers and irreversibility : verification at one step only, or permanent failure once an event happens, e.g. pouring judged only when the bottle returns upright; a third press in press_by_number.
paragraphs.zh: 时机、事件触发与不可逆性：仅在某一单步进行验证，或一旦某个事件发生即永久失败，例如只有在瓶子恢复直立时才判定倾倒动作；press_by_number 中的第三次按压。

paragraphs.en: Criteria defect : the criteria code or an asset annotation is wrong, e.g. mug 14 in hang_mugs_random, the bug in solve_equation.
paragraphs.zh: 标准缺陷：标准代码或资产标注错误，例如 hang_mugs_random 中的 mug 14，以及 solve_equation 中的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Extra end state : an end state the instruction does not mention, e.g. in make_toast the two remaining slices must stay on the bread shelf.
paragraphs.zh: 额外终止状态：指令未提及的终止状态，例如在 make_toast 中，剩余的两片面包必须留在面包架上。

paragraphs.en: Loose criteria : trajectories that skip the action the instruction asks for are accepted, e.g. sweep_blocks accepts blocks picked up without the broom.
paragraphs.zh: 宽松标准：跳过指令所要求动作的轨迹也被接受，例如 sweep_blocks 接受不用扫帚就拾起方块的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Contradiction : the criteria require the opposite of the instruction, e.g. in classify_objects_by_language the categories are named after asset folders, so a chocolate bunny counts as a wooden toy.
paragraphs.zh: 矛盾：标准与指令要求相反，例如在 classify_objects_by_language 中，类别以资产文件夹命名，因此巧克力兔子被算作木质玩具。

paragraphs.en: 23 tasks are consistent and 19 inconsistent (hidden rule 9, hidden rule and hard threshold 5, hard threshold 3, contradiction 1, defect 1); with solve_equation, whose criteria have a bug, 20 tasks and 26 variants are criteria-limited. By type, at medium or high severity: hidden rule 13, hard threshold 13, timing and events 10, defect 9, extra end state 5, loose criteria 4, contradiction 3. Other typical cases are make_kong (a tile must be drawn) and build_tower (only one configuration is accepted).
paragraphs.zh: 23 个任务一致，19 个不一致（隐藏规则 9，隐藏规则与硬阈值 5，硬阈值 3，矛盾 1，缺陷 1）；使用判定标准存在 bug 的 solve_equation 时，20 个任务和 26 个变体受标准限制。 按类型统计，在中或高严重度下：隐藏规则 13，硬阈值 13，时机与事件 10，缺陷 9，额外终局状态 5，宽松标准 4，矛盾 3。 其他典型案例包括 make_kong（必须摸一张牌）和 build_tower（只接受一种配置）。

paragraphs.en: (1) Change only run_reward and get_score, never the instruction. (2) Keep the return of both arms. (3) Remove or relax hidden rules. (4) Fix defects. (5) Tighten loose criteria where the simulator state detects the difference reliably. (6) Relax hard thresholds to what still clearly satisfies the instruction, listing old and new values. (7) Correct asset annotations in memory only. (8) Leave the original repository untouched. New criteria primitives check distance and orientation on the same feature, containment in an elliptic cylinder, and connected towers.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 只修改 run_reward 和 get_score，绝不修改 instruction。 (2) 保留双分支的返回。 (3) 移除或放宽隐藏规则。(4) 修复缺陷。 (5) 在模拟器状态能可靠检测到差异的地方，收紧宽松的判据。 (6) 将硬性阈值放宽到仍能明显满足 instruction 的程度，并列出旧值和新值。 (7) 只在内存中修正资产标注。 (8) 不改动原始仓库。 新的判据原语包括：在同一特征上检查距离和朝向、椭圆柱内的包含关系，以及连通的塔状结构。

paragraphs.en: Offline unit tests; shadow judging and reruns on seed 0; on seed 2 both criteria judge the same episodes independently (an episode ends only when both have a verdict), and every flipped episode was checked by hand.
paragraphs.zh: 离线单元测试；在种子 0 上进行影子评判和重跑；在种子 2 上，两个准则各自独立评判同一批片段（一个片段只有在两者都给出判定后才算结束），并且每一个被翻转的片段都经过了人工核查。
